title: Detection of Bacteria in Antibiotic-Treated Diatom Cultures and Cell Harvesting
author: Francesco Manfellotto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.btt5nnq6
materials: Freeze pellet immediately in liquid nitrogen

steps.title: Transfer culture to tube
steps.instruction: Pipette 1 mL of the diatom culture into a new 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Fix cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: Add neutralized formaldehyde to reach a final concentration of 1.6 % (v/v) and mix gently by inversion.

steps.title: Stain cells with DAPI
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of DAPI stock (1 mg/mL, Thermo Fisher Scientific Cat. #D1306) to the fixed cells, mix gently by inversion, and keep the tube protected from direct light.

steps.title: Load cells into glass‑bottom dish
steps.instruction: Transfer the stained cells into an ibidi µ‑Dish 35 mm high glass‑bottom dish, then incubate for 10 min away from direct light to allow cells to settle.

steps.title: Image cells to assess bacteria
steps.instruction: Place the dish on a Leica DMI‑6000 B inverted microscope. Set fluorescence excitation for chlorophyll (580 nm excitation / 604 nm emission) and for DAPI (364 nm excitation / 454 nm emission). Scan across the dish, focusing on both the cells and the dish bottom, to determine bacterial presence or absence.

substeps.instruction: Move the stage to examine multiple fields, noting any bacterial fluorescence.

steps.title: Filter cells onto membrane
steps.instruction: Pass the cell suspension through an MF‑Millipore™ membrane filter (gridded, 47 mm diameter, 1.2 µm pore size).

steps.title: Transfer filter to tube
steps.instruction: Using tweezers, place the filter into a clean 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Rinse filter and collect cells
steps.instruction: Rinse the filter with 1 mL of clean medium using a Pasteur pipette, pipetting gently to avoid cell lysis, and collect the resulting suspension in a new 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Pellet cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 15 mL tube at 2000 g for 15 min at 18 °C, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Store cell pellet at –80 °C
steps.instruction: Place the cell pellet in a –80 °C freezer for long‑term storage.
